# Haiagaru 1.6.9 (Pre-release)

## 1.6.8からの変更

- 「未読をすべて0にする」を実行してもスレ一覧の新着レス数バッジが残る問題を修正しました。保存済みの既読数だけでなく、画面が優先して参照するメモリ上の既読数も更新します。
- 対象はChMate 0.8.10.191 dev／0.8.10.226 dev／0.8.10.241／0.8.10.242 devです。以前の版で既読数だけが保存されていた場合も、再実行で表示を更新します。
- スレ一覧の画面を再生成せず更新するため、エッヂのスレ一覧が空になる問題への対策を維持しています。レスや履歴は削除しません。
- データベースの読み取りはバックグラウンドで行い、表示更新に失敗した場合は保存成功と表示更新失敗を区別して案内します。

## 配布・検証について

Android版Morphe向けMPPです。上記4版へのパッチ適用と更新経路の静的検証を行っています。今回、実機での動作確認は行っていません。243 devへの既存パッチ適用は継続しますが、今回のバッジ更新修正の対象には含みません。

よろしければ[GitHubのStar](https://github.com/areteruhiro/Haiagaru-Morphe)だけでもお願いします。励みになります。開発をご支援いただける場合は[READMEの寄付案内](https://github.com/areteruhiro/Haiagaru-Morphe#寄付)をご覧ください。

Morphe source updates work again. The source index used a timestamp format Manager couldn't read, which caused "The remote metadata file is unavailable." Refresh the Hushfeed source. Don't clear Manager data or change its signing key.

Comment tools now has a separate Hide search suggestions above comments switch. It removes TikTok's suggested-search banner above the comment count, while leaving comments and Hushfeed's optional comment-search box available. It's off by default and needs a restart.

Search settings now identify the screen they affect. The feed button, Inbox button, LIVE search, image prompts, search-page suggestions and searching within loaded comments have clearer descriptions. Poll hiding also explains that it covers ended results.

Verification: 1,490 runtime tests, 251 patch tests and both Android lint checks passed. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with no unexpected manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks; use 47.0.3 when patching.

The exact release-derived APK was installed on the S22 using its existing signing key. The suggested-search banner is absent with the new control enabled, and the comment count, close button and composer remain available. The signed-in account and original install time were preserved. The S25 source failure was diagnosed from its Manager log. Its TikTok installation wasn't replaced because its signing key differs from the local test key.

Hushfacebook v0.5.0 gathers everything since v0.4.0. It targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and still supports 577.0.0.50.72, now with 51 patches, up from 43.

## New patches

- **Hide the Reels tab dot.** No more red dot or number on the Reels tab (called Video on some accounts). Notifications, Marketplace and the other tabs keep their badges. On by default.
- **Hide the Reels tab.** Takes the Reels tab off the tab bar, and its shortcut out of the long-press menu of Facebook's icon. Reel links and reels in your feed still open (#26).
- **Keep the reel speed.** Pick a speed once and the next reels play at it (#25). On by default.
- **Hold a reel for 2x.** Press and hold a playing reel for double speed, let go to go back. Facebook's own pull-down lock works with it.
- **Default playback quality.** Data saver, Up to 480p, Up to 720p or Highest, for reels and videos.
- **Turn off double tap to like.** A double tap on a reel or video no longer likes it. The Like button still does.
- **Open Messenger from the top bar.** The Messenger icon at the top opens the Messenger app instead of Facebook's Chats (#19). In the default selection, with its switch off until you turn it on.
- **View stories anonymously.** Watch stories without being added to their viewer lists (#24).

## Fixes and changes

- **Feed.** The "Suggested for you" row of groups to join is hidden again. Facebook now sends it as one of its own promo cards, so it got past the filter.
- **Marketplace.** Search results lose their ads too, with no gaps left behind (#29).
- **Saves.** Stories and VP9 reels save at full quality with their sound, and a switch makes saves that CapCut and InShot can open.
- **AMOLED and Material You.** Cards turn black on the black page (#27), and the Android 15 bars follow the theme.
- **Messenger.** A Messenger patched with the same Manager key works with your Facebook both ways, including signing in with Continue as.
- **Diagnostic reports** leave out more IDs and tokens, and say why the feed was allowed to refresh.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every change.

## Update

1. Refresh the Hushfacebook source in Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.
2. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook **580.0.0.51.74**, build **475019344**. Facebook **577.0.0.50.72**, build **474426275**, is also supported.
3. Install over your current patched Facebook using the manager's existing signing key. Keep that key to preserve update compatibility.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/Hushfacebook#install).

## Known limitations

Every new patch was tried on a phone, and the changelog says what each check covered. A few fixes were checked with automated tests only, mostly in the diagnostic report and settings. The AI-detected reels filter still hasn't met a reel Facebook has flagged. Some reports still need the reporter's details, including WhatsApp import (#11), Xiaomi Gallery sound (#14), Media settings (#12) and a missing Reel Download button (#18).

Review diagnostic reports before sharing them. The filter can still miss private text it doesn't recognise.

## Validation

Local checks passed: 1327 runtime tests and 565 patch tests with no failures, plus both Android lints and the release-script checks. All 51 patches applied without forcing to both supported Facebook builds, with no resource or injected-code structural errors. The dependency advisory check found no advisory for gson 2.14.0, kotlin-stdlib 2.4.20 or annotations 13.0.

Hushfeed v0.24.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

New here: the daily hold works with a screen reader. It used to stop touches and nothing else, so it went up without being announced, its way out was read as ordinary text rather than as a button, and the feed behind it could still be swiped to. Translators can work in Weblate now, and the Save button on a sticker is in your language rather than always in English.

Fixed here: saving an animated sticker can be given up on, where a stalled encode used to hold one of the three background workers until the app was killed, and two more stickers after that stopped saving altogether with nothing said. A sticker save no longer keeps the screen it started from in memory. The Feature Gate Lab does its saving in the background, so turning overrides on, or saving a gate, no longer freezes the screen behind a settings restore. Comment translation stops rebuilding one of TikTok's own services for every comment in view. Every row in a settings dialog list keeps its check mark, including the ones you scroll to.

Also here: the patches keep applying when TikTok's own methods grow. Thirty five injected calls could only name sixteen registers, which a large enough method pushes its arguments past, and the failure said nothing about registers.

Validation: 706 runtime tests passed locally. The bundle carries 70 patches, passed checks for all three DEX payloads, and applied cleanly to the vendor APK. It is byte reproducible: two builds of this commit produce the same file. Needs Morphe Manager 1.29.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

Hushfeed v0.59.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`).

This is the biggest release so far. It carries everything built since 0.58.0 and the fixes for this week's bug reports.

**From the tracker**

* The seek bar is back for everyone. TikTok runs an experiment that hides it on every video except paid content, which is why it was missing from the feed but still there in the drama player. Show the progress bar now overrides that experiment, and a second one that hid the bar on videos TikTok hadn't marked as draggable. (#16)
* Watch history and Activity center work with the in-app browser guard on. The guard now protects outside websites and leaves TikTok's own pages alone. (#16)
* Hide the tab names above the feed, a new switch on the Feed tabs page, takes the Following and For You names off the top of the feed. Swiping between the feeds still works and the search button stays. (#32)
* Fill the screen with the video, a new switch under Playback, crops a video until it covers the whole screen. It's for phones where TikTok leaves a black strip under a 9:16 video. Fit the video to the screen does the opposite, and turning either one on turns the other off. (#29)
* Taking the LIVE tab off the bottom bar no longer hides TikTok's LIVE button at the top of the feed too. In regions where TikTok puts LIVE in the bottom bar it hides the corner button, and it kept doing that after Filter bottom tabs removed the tab, which left no way into LIVE from the feed. (#28)
* Split comment view on a folding phone now follows the fold while TikTok is open. (#26)
* Hide TikTok Shop in search, a new switch under Feed filter, takes the Products block out of search results. AMOLED dark theme works on an .apkm in Morphe Manager again. (#21)

**New switches and patches**

* Pause Hushfeed sits at the top of the settings. From the next start TikTok runs as if it weren't patched, so you can tell whether something is Hushfeed's doing without turning switches off one at a time.
* Wait a day to loosen the budget is new on the Screen time page. A change that tightens the budget applies at once, and one that loosens it waits for the next day. Keep a paused video paused and Leave when TikTok says time is up are new there too.
* More opens the comments and Caption above comments put the whole caption at the top of the comments. Show poll results before voting draws a comment poll's bars before you pick an answer.
* Under Feed screen, a long press on Comment, Share or Favorites can play the video at the hold speed, and the Long press row can find the sound on YouTube Music. The new Swipe-left controls patch decides what a left swipe does, and Hide the Tako bubble now covers the search results page too.
* On Feed tabs, Open TikTok on picks the tab TikTok starts on. Keep For You on a Home tap and Keep For You on a pull down stop the feed reloading under you, Show TikTok's feed buttons puts TikTok's own play, previous and next buttons on the feed, and Hide the unread badges takes the red counts off the bottom tabs.
* Feed filter adds Hide mini dramas, and Creator exceptions for accounts whose videos should stay whatever the preference filters say.
* Playback adds Speed while you hold the video and Hide TikTok's Auto scroll button.
* A save of three or more files shows a running count with a Cancel button, and a finished save offers a way to the file. Live photos saved from comments keep their motion.
* The new Network request report patch is off by default. Disable telemetry now stops the analytics uploads themselves, and Remove ads reaches the full-screen ad TikTok can open with.

**Fixes on TikTok 47.0.3**

AMOLED dark theme paints the right colors again and blackens the sheets and panels too. Video download quality and Save the original photos work, the daily hold pauses the video, and the two pause switches work. Hide comment popup ads stops the animation itself. The comment keyword filter reaches translated comments, a bigger caption size no longer splits words, and Hushfeed's settings survive TikTok's crash recovery.

The changelog has the full list.

## Checked

* 2,034 runtime tests and 421 patch tests passed, along with both Android lint checks.
* All 93 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and to the retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures, with the rebuilt resource table checked against TikTok's own and no manifest changes. The release receipt attached here has each fixture's verdicts. Use 47.0.3 when patching.
* This exact bundle was installed on a Galaxy S22 running TikTok 47.0.3. The seek bar showed on feed videos, the tab names switch took the names off and put them back, Fill the screen switched on, and Pause Hushfeed was refused with its message while Wait a day to loosen the budget was on.

Morphe Manager's simple mode picks 107 of the 130 patches, and every switch they add starts off until you turn it on. Hushfeed settings open on a shorter home page with search and seven groups. New switches hide the side menu button next to LIVE (#128), keep offline videos until you delete them (#123), hide Thoughts on profiles (#122) and leave the languages you pick out of TikTok's automatic translation (#121). Author text size now covers the post date too (#66).

## What's changed

* Author text size now sizes the post date next to the creator's name too, so the two stay the same size (#66).
* Comments settings has a new row, Don't auto translate these languages. It's empty until you fill it in (#121). Type language codes like `es, de`, and when TikTok translates for you, captions and comments in those languages stay as they were written. See translation still works when you tap it, and TikTok's own Don't translate list isn't changed.
* Keep offline videos until you delete them now covers two more ways TikTok cleared your list. With the switch on, TikTok's Auto adjust no longer lowers your offline videos limit or trims the list when TikTok starts, and the clean-up TikTok runs when its test of turning offline videos on by default ends is skipped (#123). Restart TikTok after you change the switch.
* Restoring a settings backup made on an older TikTok build now brings back the Feature Gate Lab overrides that still fit this build. The ones that don't are kept but turned off.
* Feed screen has a new switch, Hide the side menu button, off until you turn it on. It takes away the button at the top left of the feed, next to LIVE, that opens TikTok's side menu with Your orders, TikTok Minis and more. Restart TikTok after you change it (#128).
* Every patch description in Morphe Manager is rewritten in plain English. Each one now says what the patch changes, why you might want it, and whether its switch starts on or off and where to find it in Hushfeed settings. A few patch options read more clearly too, and Skip push setup is now called Skip notification setup.
* The rows in Hushfeed settings are reworded in plain English. Privacy, Comments, Downloads, Feed filter, Screen time, Region and other pages now say what each switch does and what you'll notice, without technical terms. A few titles changed too, like Stop TikTok's speed tests and Clean up shared links.
* A handful of messages and status lines are plainer too, like the Ghost mode status, the Hook status explanation, the proxy password notice and the file name preview.
* The Dark background color option in Morphe Manager now says "color code" instead of "hex code", and explains that black turns those pixels off completely on OLED screens.
* The Hushfeed settings home now shows a compact status and search above seven groups. Related pages sit together, with backups, diagnostics and the Feature Gate Lab under App & advanced. About Hushfeed keeps build details and licenses in one place. Search still takes you straight to a setting, and your saved choices carry over. Pause now explains that saved settings and changes built into the APK remain.
* Hushfeed now supports TikTok 47.1.4 only. If you're on 47.0.3 or 47.1.3, download the 47.1.4 APK from APKMirror and patch it in Morphe Manager with the same signing key, so your login and settings carry over. Feature Gate Lab keeps each override whose switch 47.1.4 still has and turns the rest off with its usual notice.
* Custom offline videos limit has a new switch in Hushfeed settings > Downloads, Keep offline videos until you delete them. It's off until you turn it on (#123). TikTok throws out the videos it saved for offline viewing after a set time, sometimes only two days, and a list saved in one go disappears in one go, watched or not. With the switch on they stay until you delete them in TikTok's Offline videos settings, which is also how you get a fresh set. TikTok can still clear ones you've already watched when your phone runs low on space, and picking a lower limit still trims the list. Keep an eye on the storage line under the offline videos limit. The switch takes effect the next time TikTok starts.
* Hide profile shortcuts has a new switch under App, Hide Thoughts on profiles, off until you turn it on (#122). It hides the Thoughts bubble TikTok puts above a profile picture, and on your own profile the prompt to share one. Restart TikTok after you change it.
* Allow screenshots and Circle to Search now also takes the secure flag off popups and floating windows that set it in their own window settings, such as TikTok's Compose popups. They reach the screen without the window calls the patch already changed, so they could still show up black in screenshots and screen recordings. The idea comes from icysymmetra's TikTok patches.
* Diagnostics has a new row, Capture the feed, for a feed problem that's easier to show than to describe. Tap it, scroll until the problem shows up, then come back and tap it again, and Hushfeed saves a text file to Download/Hushfeed. It has a line for every batch of videos the feed filters handled while it ran, with each video's verdict and the rule that hid it. Videos and creators appear only as short codes made fresh for each capture, and the file has no captions, names, handles or web addresses. Read it before you share it anyway. Nothing is recorded until you start a capture. The idea comes from icysymmetra's TikTok patches.
* The Hide the Clear display controls description now mentions pinching the screen as another way to leave Clear display (#84).
* A handful of switches now start off, like the rest of Hushfeed's switches, because their patches join the default selection. If you picked one of these patches before and want it to keep working, turn its switch back on after you update. Under Privacy that's Block contact list access, Block installed app scanning, Block location, Block clipboard reads, Block motion sensors, Don't save new searches and Show when the camera or microphone is in use. Under Comments it's Thumbs down blocks the commenter, Links in comments open and Hide comment popup ads, and under App it's Turn off haptics and Turn off screen transitions.
* Morphe Manager's simple mode now picks 107 of Hushfeed's 130 patches, up from 55, so most of them no longer need Expert mode. Every switch the newly picked patches add starts off, and TikTok looks and works the way it ships until you turn something on in Hushfeed settings. Expert mode is still how you get the other 23, and the README's Patches section lists them with the reason each one stays out. Each patch's description now says where its switch is and that it starts off.
* Morphe Manager has a new Interface group for the patches that change how TikTok looks. AMOLED dark theme, Use system font and Turn off screen transitions move there from Performance, Change app name, Custom launcher icon and Hide the launcher shortcuts from Settings, and Feed text sizes from Interaction.

## Update

Refresh the Hushfeed source in Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer and patch TikTok again. Keep the manager's existing signing key so your login and settings carry over. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK.

## Checked

* 3618 runtime tests and 699 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 130 patches applied to TikTok 47.1.4 with desktop CLI 1.18.1. Resource checks passed, and the attached release receipt records the exact bundle and its result.

Hushfeed v0.65.0 has 98 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.

## What's changed

* Mute feed videos now works on TikTok 47.1.3, and on 47.0.3 it silences photo posts with a sound too. A video is already quiet when you swipe to it, and it stays quiet after you watch the same video from a DM or scroll a long profile grid. DMs, stories and LIVE keep their sound, and another app's music keeps playing.
* Press and hold the Home tab to open Hushfeed's settings (#45). A tap on Home works as before.
* Every save says it's been taken the moment you ask, including the ones waiting in line. If TikTok closes in the middle of a save, a banner says which saves didn't finish the next time you open it.
* Saves connect only to the server address Hushfeed checked, so nothing can swap in a different machine between the check and the download.
* The block control, the mute button and Hushfeed's other buttons over the video now show on videos opened from a creator's profile, a hashtag or a sound.
* When the time budget runs out partway through a long video, the notice and the hold come right then, and the budget label leaves as soon as you switch tabs.
* New row under Downloads, Forget saved videos. It empties the already-saved record and keeps your files.
* On Android 10 and older, the block button, Unblock and Save media on a sticker no longer close TikTok.
* Your keyboard no longer rewrites a package name or host you type into the share settings.
* Diagnostics can record a screen's layout for a "please hide this" report, and the feed filter table has a line for every route that delivers videos.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFeed/blob/v0.65.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2490 runtime tests and 459 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 98 patches applied to both supported APKs. Resource checks passed, with no manifest changes. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* On phones and Android emulators running TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3, the mute silenced feed videos and photo posts while another app's music kept playing, saves went through the checked address, and holding Home opened Hushfeed's settings. A locked budget, What's new, the block control's larger tap area and Stay on the video in full screen behaved as described.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. An older Manager says the bundle needs a Manager update. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.65.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.

## 1.0.0 (2026-10-03)

### Features

- **Block stream ads:** replace detected live-stream ads with direct Twitch playback from alternate player contexts, preferring matching quality without an external stream proxy.
- **Hide feed and display ads:** remove sponsored feed cards and display advertisements.
- **Hide Turbo promotions:** remove Turbo entries, upsells and purchase buttons while retaining train overlays.
- **Hide subscription discount banners:** remove subscription offers and promotional labels while retaining normal subscription actions.
- **Auto-claim bonus channel points:** claim available bonus rewards during live playback.
- **BTTV and 7TV emotes:** render global and channel emotes in chat and show provider previews on tap.
- **Reload stream:** add a double-tap reload control to native, Classic Split, Vertical View and swipe-feed players, with a single-tap hint.
- **Block client-requested ads:** optionally suppress native ad requests.
- **Playback diagnostics:** provide playlist and playback diagnostics, disabled by default.
- **Inspect Twitch APK:** report package, version and DEX information without modifying the APK.

### Integration

- Add a native-style Patch settings page containing only the selected features, with saved preferences across same-key updates.
- Preserve Twitch's native and React Native player and chat paths, including V2 emote previews and Reload on initial Classic Split entry.
- Include reproducible build, test and APK evaluation tools, synthetic hook tests and original-aware DEX verification.

### Compatibility

- Evaluated target: Twitch **31.3.0 (3103006)**, ARM64, Android 13.
- Extended ad coverage remains under evaluation. An unmatched-media midroll case remains under investigation; story ads are not covered.
- Google Play billing is unavailable in the re-signed app. Other versions and ABIs require separate verification.

f8516b5ae3296fdcaae802d2:
- Add **Fix article list loading**: PTT now brackets its screen repaints with the synchronized output sequences `ESC[?2026h` / `ESC[?2026l`. JPTT's terminal emulator has no case for the `h` and `l` final bytes, so it keeps appending to its 32 character escape buffer, swallowing the screen content that follows and printing fragments of the sequence as visible text. Entering a board never got past the wait for 請按任意鍵繼續 and the article list sat at 載入中 until it gave up with 載入失敗. This filters the sequences the emulator cannot parse out of the stream before they reach it.
- **Preload article images**: implement `onProgressUpdate` on the Fresco subscriber. `BaseDataSubscriber` in the APK has no implementation to inherit — R8 dropped the empty override because the one subclass it kept declares its own — so the first progress report from a download threw `AbstractMethodError` on Fresco's network thread, where none of this extension's `catch` blocks can see it, and the app died on opening any article with images. Also handle `onCancellation`, so a cancelled fetch releases its worker immediately instead of after the 90 s timeout.

Hushfeed v0.66.0 has 102 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 and 47.1.4 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer.

## What's changed

* TikTok 47.1.4 is supported now, beside 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (#56). Every patch applies to each of the three.
* Hushfeed's settings come in Italian (#61) and Russian (#60). They're first passes, so if a label reads oddly, please open an issue and say which one.
* Change app name is a new patch that puts a name you pick under the app icon and in Android's app list (#59). Type the name in the patch's options in Morphe Manager.
* Keep a streak going, also new, sends one message a day to someone you pick, at a time you pick. Set it up under Hushfeed settings > Inbox > Streak.
* For a follow or a like that undoes itself on a patched build, try the new Look like the store app patch (#55). It's off by default. Turn it on under Hushfeed settings > Privacy and restart TikTok.
* With the new Keep playing in the background patch, a video keeps going after you leave TikTok or turn the screen off (#52).
* The share sheet no longer shows "Tap again to send" on a friend you never touched (#58). You can also add apps of your own to its Share via row.
* Fit the video to the screen fits a video again when the space around it changes size (#29).
* Two new switches: Let the last video finish on the Screen time page, and Hide effect and template tags on the Feed screen page (#51).
* Patching is faster (#54), and Stop on-device AI profiling works again.
* The diagnostic report has FEED MUTE and VIDEO FIT sections, so a report of a silent feed or a badly fitted video shows what Hushfeed did.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushFeed/blob/v0.66.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2565 runtime tests and 480 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 102 patches applied to all three supported APKs. Resource checks passed. The manifest gains three permissions, all from Keep a streak going and only when it's selected: start at boot and two for exact alarms. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* On an Android emulator running TikTok 47.1.3, Keep a streak going's message arrived from its alarm while TikTok was closed, and again when TikTok was opened after a missed time. On a phone, patching the recommended set in Morphe Manager took about 6 1/2 minutes, down from 8 3/4.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. An older Manager says the bundle needs a Manager update. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3, 47.1.3 or 47.1.4 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.66.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.

- Require both shared permissions to retain signature protection. Check their DEX sites before renaming the manifest permissions.
- Validate every method in a control before editing it, then publish its settings capability only after success. Reject changed browser parameters and plugin return constants.
- Keep both supported build codes visible in Morphe's compatibility description.
- Keep controls reachable in short windows with large text by moving the branding and reminder into the scroll area. Let navigation scroll when the keyboard leaves very little room. Preserve the normal portrait layout.
- Restore search selection and each page's scroll position, refresh switches when returning to settings, and keep focus on visible controls.
- Explain bubble availability on Android 9 and 10 without discarding the saved choice. Add accessible page names, correct right-to-left spacing and explain that choices apply to every account in the installation.
- Reject incomplete or conflicting certificate, permission and package records during the installation check. Include apps installed in other Android profiles.
- Check arm64 libraries, ELF page alignment and Android's native extraction rules. The optional `--stock-apk` argument verifies that a rebuild preserves the tested stock libraries.
- Return clear errors for missing inputs, tool timeouts, corrupt compressed native libraries and malformed changed-APK reports. Read wrapped dependency errors and keep temporary APK cleanup on failure.

- Pass 103 local tests. Android lint reports no errors and the same eight warnings as the baseline.
- Rebuild both supported APKs with all 21 patches, verify their v3 signatures and preserve every native library. Two clean bundle builds produce the same checksum.
- Exercise both settings pages and themes on an isolated S22 display. Check small windows, 200% text and keyboard-visible search on a headless Android 16 emulator.

## 1.2.0-dev.21
f9b4b3e03961b493b452a775:
Hushfacebook 0.1.7 brings back the settings shortcut from #2. Facebook pushes three shortcuts of its own whenever it posts notifications, so on a launcher that shows only a few, Hushfacebook dropped off the end. It stays first now. Long-press Facebook's icon on your home screen to find it.

There's a new patch, Clean up Reels. It takes the Follow button off reels and hides the comment and reaction previews Facebook shows under them. The Remix, template, Stars and link-out buttons go too, and each part has its own switch under Reels and Watch. It starts off in Morphe Manager.

Downloads have two new settings. Download quality holds every saved video to 1080p, 720p, 480p or 360p, or picks the smallest file. Video file name builds names from a template with `{date}` and `{video_id}`. Download any reel is on by default now, so a fresh patch puts a Download button on every reel.

Saved files get the right extension when Facebook's server labels them wrong. A gallery write that fails is reported and cleaned up, and if the gallery won't let go of an unfinished save, the first save after a restart tries again. With Open links in external browser on, fb.watch, m.me and Facebook's other short links open inside Facebook again. The settings screen is easier to read on the black page and says what each row does in all five languages. It won't close Facebook any more when no browser can open the source link.

All 22 patches applied without force to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, with no manifest changes. Local checks passed: 468 extension tests, 166 patch tests and both Android lints.

On a signed-in test phone (Galaxy S22, Android 16), the update went on through Morphe Manager and kept the login, and Hushfacebook shows first when you long-press Facebook's icon. A reel saved with the quality set to 720p came out as a 720p file named from the template. Clean up Reels kept the comment preview off the reels it showed.

Known issue: on the Reels tab, the Follow button beside a reel's author still shows with Clean up Reels on. The fix is next.

Requires Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a Facebook bundle. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK.

Adds thumbs-down voting on individual replies and repairs the stale topic state returned to the thread list.

- Reply downvotes use the app's native permissions, selected state, and net score (upvotes minus downvotes).
- Thumb icons match the stock size and retain the native brief bounce animation after voting.
- Back navigation returns the refreshed topic model, allowing the list to receive updated server unread state.

Validated with 24 isolated JVM checks, strict stock-APK patch/decode/signature/alignment checks, altered-bytecode rejection, and Android 14 emulator checks in light/dark themes. A user-authorized downvote changed `+0` to `-1` and persisted after refresh.

Live undo/error rollback, the blue-dot transition on a naturally unread thread, and physical-device testing remain unverified. See the repository's `validation/emulator-20261003.md` for details.

Download `redflagdeals-revanced-patches-1.1.0.rvp` and apply **Fix RedFlagDeals Forums** to an unmodified RedFlagDeals Forums **1.11.7** APK using ReVanced Manager or CLI. Existing Manager source subscriptions discover the update after publication. This release distributes the patch bundle only.

HushPinterest 0.0.6 has 26 patches for Pinterest 14.38.0. It's built on Morphe patcher 1.15.1, so it needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. New this time are Download board, Long-press download and Hide survey prompts, and Morphe Manager now selects every patch but Spoof signature for Google sign-in by default, with the newly selected ones' switches starting off.

This is the first release without Pinterest 14.25.0. On Android 9, keep HushPinterest 0.0.5 with Pinterest 14.25.0.

## What's new

- HushPinterest now patches Pinterest 14.38.0 only, which needs Android 10 or newer. On Android 9, keep HushPinterest 0.0.5 with Pinterest 14.25.0.
- Morphe Manager's default selection now holds every patch but Spoof signature for Google sign-in, so you don't need Expert mode to find a feature. The 16 patches that joined it start with their switches off, so a build patched with the defaults acts like Pinterest until you turn one on in HushPinterest settings. Hide ads, Disable analytics, Strip link tracking and Hide advertising ID still start on.
- Hide AI-labeled pins now starts off. If you updated without ever changing it, it's off now, so turn it back on from the Feed page of HushPinterest settings if you want it.
- In Expert mode, Disable update nag sits under Updates and the two button patches under Navigation, so the Interface group is shorter to read.
- Each patch's description in Morphe Manager now says which page of HushPinterest settings holds its switch, and whether that switch starts on or off.
- Patch descriptions in Morphe Manager are rewritten in plain English. Each one says what the patch changes, why you might want it, and ends with where its switch is and whether it starts on or off.
- Setting rows in HushPinterest settings are reworded in plain English, with restart reminders and clearer notes on when a change shows. Translations for German, Spanish, Indonesian, Brazilian Portuguese and Turkish are updated to match.
- Download, setup guide, import and update-check messages are plainer and say what to do next. Translations are updated to match.
- New Download board patch. It adds Download board to a board's menu, which saves every pin Pinterest has loaded for that board (up to 500) the same way Download pins does. Pins already in Download history are skipped, and when it's done you see how many were saved, skipped or unsupported, with a reminder that only loaded pins are included. So scroll to the end of a board first if you want all of it. Download pins has to be on too. The switch starts off on the Pin actions page, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, the board menu is Pinterest's own. Nothing new is asked of Pinterest apart from the media downloads themselves.
- New Long-press download patch. Hold a pin in a grid and Pinterest's round menu gets a Download button after its own buttons. Slide onto it and let go, and the pin saves the same way Download pin in the pin menu saves it, so it shows up in Download history too. Download pins has to be on as well. The switch starts off on the Pin actions page, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, the menu is Pinterest's own. Boards and anything else you hold keep Pinterest's buttons.
- New Hide survey prompts patch. Pinterest sometimes opens with a "Got a minute? Take a quick survey" invite. With the switch on, HushPinterest turns it down before it shows, the same way tapping Maybe later does, so Pinterest marks that survey dismissed and doesn't queue it again on the next launch. Advertiser sponsored polls, which Pinterest opens as their own pop-up rather than in the feed, are skipped too. The switch starts off on the Interface page, and with it off or HushPinterest paused, Pinterest shows its invites and polls as before. An invite that's already on screen stays until you close it.

## Behind the scenes

- The heavy desktop jobs now wait for a slot in the machine's build queue when `BUILD_QUEUE_SCRIPT` names one: CLI patch runs, split bundle merges, the resource table check, the dex and host reference checks and fingerprint ranking. They show up in the queue's status and no longer start beside two Gradle builds. A release receipt asks for release priority. The push hook reads `BUILD_QUEUE_SCRIPT` from the user environment too, and without a build wrapper its Gradle run waits for a slot as well.
- The patch tests that open the Pinterest APKs now run in their own Gradle task, `:patches:fixtureTest`, and `:patches:test` refuses any test that tries to read one. Each APK is unzipped once per run instead of once per test, and its decoded manifest is kept the same way. The push check runs the fixture task after the quick checks, and the task fails when it runs no tests, or when it skips one while the fixtures are required.
- Updated four runtime checks to match the current setup, link and download messages.
- A release now ends with `scripts/verify-published-index.ps1`. It asks GitHub for the latest release and for the patches-bundle.json that main serves, and fails when they disagree, naming any index commit that never got pushed. For most of October 7, v0.0.5 was out while the index still said 0.0.4, so Morphe Manager didn't offer the update to anyone on 0.0.4. It came up in #3.
- A patch test now fails when the extension carries a class from outside its own package, apart from the three Kotlin helpers it has always kept. The patcher lays such a class over Pinterest's own copy, and Download board's lookup of Kotlin's Unit had briefly pulled one in.
- Added [measured factory network and background activity](docs/pinterest-14.38.0-runtime.md), with reusable comparison data, CPU and media timers, memory samples and scheduled-worker records. Kept physical battery drain explicitly unmeasured until an unplugged phone run is available.
- Added a [signed-in factory audit](docs/pinterest-14.38.0-audit.md) with ad-delivery traces, privacy boundaries, all 23 patch mappings, native settings, screenshots and specific work to investigate next. Clarified that analytics filtering covers selected paths.
- Mapped the factory Pinterest 14.38.0 APK and first-run screen, with patch anchors for future updates.

## Update from 0.0.5

1. Morphe Manager offers 0.0.6 from the HushPinterest patch source. Patch Pinterest 14.38.0 and install it over your current Pinterest. Your sign-in and switches stay, as long as Morphe Manager signs it with the same key as before.
2. Download board, Long-press download and Hide survey prompts are new and selected by default, with their switches off. Download board and Long-press download are on the Pin actions page of HushPinterest settings and need Download pins on too. Hide survey prompts is on the Interface page.
3. Hide AI-labeled pins now starts off. If you never changed it, turn it back on from the Feed page if you want it.
4. Still on Pinterest 14.25.0 because your phone runs Android 9? Stay on 0.0.5, since this release doesn't patch 14.25.0.

## New install

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 1.34.0 or newer.
2. Add HushPinterest as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushPinterest
3. Download Pinterest **14.38.0**, version code **14388010**, as the universal APK, and patch it. It needs Android 10 or newer.
4. Uninstall the stock Pinterest first, since Android won't put one over the other. Save anything you keep only on the phone before you do. Your boards and pins come back when you sign in.
5. Sign in with your email and a Pinterest password. If you joined through Google or Facebook, tap **Forgot your password?** on Pinterest's login page to set one first.
6. Right after your first patch, export Morphe Manager's signing key (Settings, then System, then Import & export, then Signing key) and keep it somewhere private. Updates only install over a Pinterest signed with that same key.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Pinterest APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#install). `SHA256SUMS.txt` is signed with the HushPinterest release key, fingerprint `FCE5 ECE3 182A 647B 3AF2  C5ED 2DC3 5E8D 5C00 E8A6`. [How to check a download](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushPinterest#verify-a-release-download).

## Validation

All 186 patch tests and 705 extension tests passed on this commit, none skipped. The bundle attached here was patched onto a real Pinterest 14.38.0 APK with Morphe's desktop patcher, and all 26 patches applied without forcing. `release-receipt-0.0.6.json` records that result, the APK's hash and what patching changed in the app's manifest.

Hushfeed v0.63.0 has 98 patches for global TikTok 47.0.3 and 47.1.3 (`com.zhiliaoapp.musically`). It includes the changes developed in 0.62.0, which wasn't published separately.

## What's changed

* Mute feed videos adds a movable sound button without changing the phone's volume. Stay on the video in full screen keeps the full-screen viewer on the current video when it ends.
* Downloads can show progress, save a caption and source details beside a video, organize files by creator and offer an existing saved copy before downloading again. Storage and deadline failures now stop multi-file saves consistently, and interrupted sticker writes remove their unfinished output.
* Feed limits leave profile grids and your own posts intact. Caption-language filtering has its own setting.
* Feature Gate Lab uses the installed TikTok build's gate list. Its compact layout leaves more room for results, and a reviewed 47.1.3 preset restores See translation. Failed structured edits retain their draft.
* Budget changes and settings checklists save together, with recoverable choices when storage fails. Failed exports clean up the file they created. Undo respects Android's requested time to act, and the Calm feed card fits larger text in both themes.
* Diagnostics remove credentials and identifiers before writing to logs or crash files. Ghost mode also guards story play reports and shows local reporting state or a failed check beside its switch. This still does not prove that TikTok omits you from a story's viewer list.
* Release receipts now bind the bundle to its clean source commit and build inputs.

See the [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/hushfeed/blob/v0.63.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.

## Checked

* 2303 runtime tests passed and 454 patch tests passed. Both Android lint checks passed.
* All 98 patches applied to both supported APKs. Resource checks passed, with no unexpected manifest changes. The attached release receipt records the exact bundle and each target's result.
* The audit candidate ran on a physical Galaxy S22. Settings checks covered both themes, 200% text, budget edits, checklists, backups and Lab export. The original installation and saved preferences were restored afterward.

Two-account Ghost verification and the reported LIVE, Fold, memory and split-APK cases remain open.

## Install

Use Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source, select the TikTok 47.0.3 or 47.1.3 APK, then patch and install it. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.

`patches-0.63.0.mpp` is the patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. `SHA256SUMS.txt` includes checksums for the bundle and its release receipt.

- fix(YouTube Music - Dark theme): Gradient not applied to playlist header background

Hushfacebook 0.2.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, and 577.0.0.50.72 still works. It's the batch of fixes held back since 0.1.8, with 27 patches now, five of them new.

New patches:

- **Install beside Meta's apps** (on by default). The official Messenger, Facebook Lite, Business Suite and Workplace can now be installed next to a patched Facebook without `INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION`. If you patched before, patch again and install over the top. It's an ordinary update and Facebook keeps its data.
- **Stop update prompts** (on by default). A patched Facebook can't install Meta's updates, so it stops asking.
- **Use the system font** and **Use the phone's emoji** (both off until you pick them in Manager) draw Facebook's text and emoji with your phone's own fonts.
- **Don't send reel watch history** (off until you pick it) keeps the list of reels you watch from going back to Facebook.

Other changes:

- Long-press the Facebook logo at the top of your feed to open Hushfacebook's settings (#2). A tap still does what it always did.
- Hide AI-detected posts has a second switch for Reels and Watch.
- The Video file name setting takes `{owner}` and `{posted}`, so `{owner}_{posted}` saves a video as `Some Page_20260925.mp4` (#6).
- An opt-in check tells you when a new Hushfacebook release is out. It's off by default and never downloads anything.
- The settings screen shows which rows open something, and the diagnostic report choices fit at large text sizes.
- The README has a Troubleshooting section for Manager's error messages and a section on what Meta can see.

The full list is in CHANGELOG.md.

Checked on a signed-in test phone (Galaxy S22, Android 16) through Morphe Manager, installed over the top with the login kept: a long press on the Facebook logo opened the settings, a tap stayed Facebook's, and the Stories tray row reads as it should.

All 27 patches applied without force to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72. The only manifest change is the two renamed Meta permissions from Install beside Meta's apps. Local checks passed: 575 extension tests, 273 patch tests and both Android lints.

Requires Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a (240-640dpi) (Android 11+) Facebook bundle from APKMirror. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's signing key when you update.
